property.label: HubSpot property
property.description: Picked from the portal's real properties
options.objectField.label: Object field
options.objectField.description: Name of the sibling field holding the HubSpot object (e.g. hsObject). Leave empty to list every object's properties.
options.optionsField.label: Options field
options.optionsField.description: Name of the sibling repeatable holding this field's choices (value/label entries), filled by the import button on enumeration properties. Defaults to "options".
object.label: HubSpot object
object.description: Picked from the portal's configured objects
picker.not-configured: No HubSpot API key — free text. Set it in Settings → HubSpot.
picker.object-unavailable: Properties of “{object}” unreadable — missing scope on the token.
picker.no-results: No matching property — properties are managed in HubSpot.
picker.imported: Options imported — save to keep them.
settings.subtitle: The private app token used to read the portal's properties and validate form mappings.
settings.key.label: Private app token
settings.key.hint: A key entered here overrides the ones from config/plugins.ts and HUBSPOT_API_KEY.
settings.test-error: HubSpot unreachable — invalid or revoked key?
settings.scopes: The token needs the crm.schemas.contacts.read and crm.schemas.companies.read scopes to list properties. It is never returned to the browser: only its existence, its source and its last four characters are.
audit.title: Mapping audit
audit.subtitle: Scans every entry of the validated content types and lists the mappings the portal would reject today — including properties deleted in HubSpot since they were saved.
audit.no-targets: No content type to audit — declare them under `validate` in the plugin config.
audit.clean: Nothing to report — every mapping is valid.
failures.title: Failed submissions
failures.subtitle: Submissions HubSpot couldn't take after the automatic retries. They can be inspected under Content Manager → HubSpot failed submissions.
problem.unknown: “{property}” does not exist on {object} in this portal
menu.label: HubSpot Forms
forms.title: HubSpot forms
forms.subtitle: Multi-step forms with conditional fields, mapped to your portal's real properties.
forms.empty: No form yet — name one above to open the builder.
forms.structure: {steps, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} · {fields, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}
editor.locale-copied: New locale started from the default structure — save to keep it.
editor.invalid: The structure has problems — see the flagged cards.
editor.publish-blocked: Publishing is blocked — fix the flagged mappings first.
editor.step-delete: Delete the step and its fields
editor.form-hint: Select a step or a field to edit it. The public endpoint serves this form at /api/hubspot/forms/{slug}.
panel.label: Label
panel.name: Payload key
panel.name-hint: Key of the answer in the submission — unique in the form.
panel.property-hint: Without a property, the answer is sent under the payload key.
panel.problem-unknown: This property is unknown to the portal.
panel.problem-wrong-object: This property lives on another object.
panel.problem-whitespace: The stored property has surrounding spaces.
panel.problem-bad-option: A choice below is not accepted by the portal's enumeration.
condition.no-candidates: Conditions can only read fields placed earlier in the form.
forms.import-hint: Converts a legacy content-type form (all locales) into a draft here — same slug, source untouched. Re-importing overwrites the draft.
form-picker.label: HubSpot form
form-picker.description: A form built in the HubSpot form builder, stored by slug
forms.import-hubspot-hint: Translates a form built in HubSpot into a draft here, CRM mapping included. What the builder can't express is skipped and reported. Re-importing overwrites the draft.
forms.hubspot-list-error: Could not list the portal's forms — the token needs the `forms` read scope.
forms.skipped-hidden: "{label}" skipped — hidden fields are not supported yet
forms.skipped-duplicate: "{label}" skipped — the name "{detail}" is already used
forms.skipped-condition: Condition on "{label}" dropped — no equivalent operator ({detail})
forms.skipped-rich-text: A content block was skipped — the builder has no rich-text element
forms.skipped-consent: The GDPR consent block was skipped — rebuild it as a field if needed
submissions.title: Submissions
submissions.subtitle: Every answer received by the built forms — stored whatever the CRM's mood.
submissions.empty-form: No submission for this form yet.
